title: Dialogues

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: Calling a training centre
steps.body: A learner asks about a fictional registration process.

examples.fr: Bonjour, je voudrais savoir si l'inscription est encore ouverte.
examples.en: Awa: Hello, I would like to know whether registration is still open.

examples.fr: Pourriez-vous me dire quels documents il faut envoyer ?
examples.en: Awa: Could you tell me which documents need to be sent?

examples.fr: Le formulaire et une preuve d'adresse.
examples.en: Agent: The form and proof of address.

examples.fr: Si j'ai bien compris, je peux les envoyer par courriel ?
examples.en: Awa: If I understood correctly, I can send them by email?

steps.title: Following up about a service
steps.body: A caller confirms where and when to get help.

examples.fr: À qui dois-je m'adresser pour faire un suivi ?
examples.en: Sam: Whom should I contact to follow up?

examples.fr: Vous pouvez joindre le bureau entre neuf et seize heures.
examples.en: Agent: You can reach the office between nine and four.

examples.fr: Pourriez-vous préciser le délai de réponse ?
examples.en: Sam: Could you specify the response time?

examples.fr: Il est normalement de cinq jours ouvrables.
examples.en: Agent: It is usually five business days.

examples.fr: Merci. Je retournerai au centre si je n'ai pas reçu de réponse.
examples.en: Sam: Thank you. I will go back to the centre if I have not received a response.
